blocks.subtitle: A five-year research project uniting 42 partners across 17 countries to help cardiac patients through early, personalised interventions.

block1.title: About EXIT-CVD
block1.content:
The **EXIT-CVD** research consortium, co-funded by the **European Union Innovative Health Initiative (IHI)**, aims to transform how cardiovascular disease is detected, monitored and treated.
It acts on three key exit points along the cardiac care journey: - **Early Exit** — Preventing disease through digital monitoring and early detection - **Mid Exit** — Reversing progression through personalised risk assessment - **Late Exit** — Halting progression with advanced therapies

block2.title: By the Numbers
block2.content:
| | |
|---|---|
| **42** Partners | **17** Countries |
| **22** Clinical Studies | **14,000+** Patients |

Led by **UMCG** and **Philips**, with a total budget of EUR 27.6 million, co-funded by the EU Innovative Health Initiative.

blocks.title: Powered by Onsentia & RADAR-base
blocks.content:
Onsentia powers the digital data collection and remote monitoring infrastructure for EXIT-CVD using the open-source **RADAR-base** platform.
The platform combines: - **Active monitoring (aRMT)** — Patient-reported outcome questionnaires - **Passive monitoring (pRMT)** — Sensor and wearable data collection - **Huawei D3 Watch** — Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring This enables multi-source, scalable, real-time remote monitoring and data integration across clinical trials.

content.title: COMPASS Study
content.content: Led by **King's College London / GSTT**. Huawei Health provides ambulatory blood pressure monitoring via its D3 Watch. Onsentia's platform collects the data. MEGI delivers AI-powered cardiovascular assessments, and CogStack identifies participants from medical records.

content.title: EMPOWER-BP Study
content.content: Led by **UMC Utrecht** with partners across Europe. Uses a citizen science approach with remote self-enrolment via social media and the Huawei D3 Watch, engaging patients directly in their health management.

blocks.title: Innovation That Reaches Everyone
blocks.content:
EXIT-CVD embeds **implementation science** and **equity-by-design** principles to ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and accessible to all populations — including those historically underserved.
A FAIR-compliant data platform aligned with the **European Health Data Space (EHDS)** supports integration, evaluation, and real-world scalability.

items.title: 1. Check eligibility and provide consent
items.content: Complete a brief eligibility check, read the Participant Information Sheet, and sign an electronic consent form.

items.title: 2. Set up your study account
items.content: Create an account with your email and a password. Verify your email to proceed.

items.title: 3. Connect your devices
items.content: Connect the Huawei D3 Watch, install the RADAR Active App (aRMT) for questionnaires, and the RADAR Passive App (pRMT) for passive data collection.

items.title: 4. Participate in monitoring
items.content: Wear the Huawei D3 Watch as instructed, complete questionnaires via the Active App, and keep the Passive App running on your smartphone.
